newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-AVERAGE GROSS WAGE ROSE 23 PCT IN Q4 1996.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-AVERAGE GROSS WAGE ROSE 23 PCT IN Q4 1996.

text.p: The average gross wage in Estonia rose by 23 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with the same period in 1995, the statistics office said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement that the average gross wage in the fourth quarter was 3,310 kroons or 19.13 kroons per hour. In the third quarter, the average wage was 2,980 kroons.

The highest paid sectors in the fourth quarter were the financial sector, where the average wage was 6,728 kroons a month. The mining sector came next on 4,742 kroons a month while the energy sector had an average wage of 4,315 kroons.
The lowest paid sector was the farm and hunting sector, where the average monthly salary was 1,872 kroons and the hotel and restaurant business, where the average salary was 2,268 kroons.
